node.ai.openai.chat.name: OpenAI Chat API
node.ai.openai.responses.name: OpenAI Responses API
node.ai.openai.chat.description: Send text or a messages array to Chat Completions. Model and input are required. Unset optional parameters are omitted. Returns text and response JSON.
node.ai.openai.responses.description: Send text or an input array to Responses. Supports saved prompts and previous responses. Omit optional input/settings when unset. Returns completed text and response JSON.
node.ai.openai.chat.message.name: Append Chat message
node.ai.openai.responses.message.name: Append Responses message
node.ai.openai.chat.message.description: Append a role/content message to a previous messages array. Content accepts text or API content parts. Tool messages require a tool call ID.
node.ai.openai.responses.message.descrip: Append a role/content message to a Responses input array. Chain nodes to build ordered conversations.
Use either a conversation or a previous: Use either a conversation or a previous response ID.
